args.summary: The latest production release v2.3.1 of checkout-api failed health checks across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate of ~18%. Remediation: rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent previously-healthy production release. The initial rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator halted after us-east); a retry completed the rollback to us-west and eu-west. Service is now confirmed healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with an error rate of ~0.2%. Follow-up: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 health check failures and the orchestrator error seen during the first rollback attempt before re-releasing.
